title: Getting started
dek: Your first hours: what to gather, which bench to build first, and the tools and weapons you can make from the starting area.
audience: A new player in the first biome.

blocks.template: Break rocks, trees and rubble with a melee weapon or your bare hands. With a gun or bow out, nothing drops.

Everything below can be had in the first biome, {first_biome}. Most things in Human Host can also turn up in crates and on bodies anywhere, so this list is what you can count on, not all you might find.

sections.heading: What you can make by hand

blocks.template: Hand crafting needs no bench. These recipes use only first-biome materials.
Each bench unlocks its own recipes. These can be built from first-biome materials, in the order their ingredients allow.
Everything here is made from things you can mine or gather in {first_biome}. None of it needs a part you have to find in a crate or on a body.
Generated from game version {game_version} (Steam build {build_id}). "First biome" means biome 1, the ring around the spawn point. Gathering needs a melee weapon or bare hands.
